items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I think this was attributed to Artie Shaw... He said, 'Jazz was born in a whisky barrel...'

ctx.x: What other bands were playing in New York then, when you were there?

Well, at that time, let's see, the Casa Loma Band had come into the Roseland Ballroom and made quite a hit. Claude Hopkins' band was playing there also. And let's see, well, the inevitable Phil Spitalny and of course Freddie Martin, and Vincent Lopez. Let's see, I'm not sure, I think Hal Kemp was already gone from the Taft, but George Hall. And oh, there were -- this was before Shaw started his thing and it was before the Dorseys. The Dorseys, I think -- the Dorsey Brothers, that year, I think they came the…
I think I have that somewhere in these notes, but I'll have to find it later.
